title: microburst reconciler: predictive soft-SLA hedging and reservation amortizer
author: Asha Patel
release_notes: Adds a microburst reconciliation agent that smooths short-lived burst allocations and a soft-SLA hedging mechanism to reduce oscillation during sudden demand spikes. Includes telemetry for per-tenant microburst utilization and a small API extension for querying transient reservation state.
description:
Motivation:
High-frequency microbursts cause noisy autoscaler decisions and short-lived reservation churn in Dedicated clusters. Teams observed elevated SLA violations during rapid request ramps because small temporary reservations preemptively inflate headroom calculations and throttle long-tail tenants. This PR introduces a microburst reconciler that amortizes transient reservations, plus a predictive soft-SLA hedging policy to reduce oscillation.

What this change does (single string):
- Introduces a new reconciler component (microburst_reconciler) that tracks transient reservations and decays their weight over a short half-life window so autoscaler and allocator decisions treat them as fractional capacity rather than full steady-state reservations.
- Adds a "hedge_factor" option to the DedicatedAutoscaler config: a tunable fractional buffer (0.0-0.2) applied when predictive signals detect a rising ramp pattern. Hedge factor temporarily increases soft limits to reduce churn and avoid reactive preemptions.
- Implements predictive ramp detector using smoothed percentiles of request-rate and per-tenant active concurrency to flag microburst patterns.
- Emits new telemetry: microburst.reserve_fraction, microburst.decayed_reservations, predictive_hedge_trigger (boolean) at tenant and fleet scope.
- Small API: GET /v1/dedicated/reservations/transient?tenant_id=<id> for operators to inspect reconciler state.

Checklist:
- [x] Design doc linked (Linear ENG-1423)
- [x] Unit tests for decay math and reconciliation logic
- [x] Integration test with autoscaler simulation harness
- [x] Telemetry labels and dashboards updated
- [x] Backwards-compatible config defaults (hedge_factor defaults to 0.0)

Risk and mitigation:
This changes autoscaler inputs; default config keeps behavior unchanged. Hedge_factor defaults to 0.0 and reconciler decay is conservative (half-life = 12s). We added feature flags to enable in canary fleets only. Observability added to validate impact before wide rollout.

Related work:
- ENG-1458: per-tenant utilization telemetry improvements
- SUP-3192: incident investigation note for transient reservation thrash

Summary of commits:
- "add microburst reconciler core loop and decay model" (core/reconciler/microburst_reconciler.go)
- "wire reconciler into allocator decision path and add feature flag" (scheduler/allocator.go)
- "predictive ramp detector based on smoothed request-rate percentiles" (autoscaler/detector.go)
- "expose transient reservation API and CLI inspect command" (api/reservations_handler.go, cli/reservations_inspect.go)
- "telemetry labels, dashboards, and tests" (telemetry/*, tests/*)

review_comments: Anika Shah: The decay half-life value seems conservative but we need a test showing sensitivity across 3x and 10x bursts; please add simulation results.
Author (Asha Patel): Added integration sim scenarios and summarized sensitivity numbers in docs/ops/microburst_reconciler.md.
Marcus Li: Can we ensure predictive detector won't be noisy for low-traffic tenants? Suggest minimum sample window and tenant-level gating.
Author: Updated detector to gate on minSamples=10 and ignore tenants under 0.5 RPS to avoid false positives.
Evan Brooks: Telemetry cardinality is a concern; can we restrict microburst.reserve_fraction to tenant buckets only when > 0.01?
Author: Added cardinality guard and metric label 'reservable=true' only when decayed_fraction > 0.01.
notes_for_operators: Canary rollout: enable feature flag 'microburst_reconciler' in one small dedicated fleet and monitor telemetry microburst.decayed_reservations and predictive_hedge_trigger. Start with hedge_factor=0.05 if you see frequent preemptions. Rolling back: disable feature flag and allow 60s for decayed reservations to expire.
